request.objective: Normalize CSV ledger rows and aggregate exact decimal amounts
request.task:
Implement parse_ledger(text) accepting a CSV string with exact header date,category,amount. Return a list of dicts with ISO calendar-valid YYYY-MM-DD date (reject noncanonical formats), nonempty stripped category and amount string quantized to two decimal digits with Decimal(str(x)) ROUND_HALF_UP. Preserve row order and Unicode. Reject malformed headers/row widths/invalid dates/nonfinite or malformed amounts with ValueError. Blank input is invalid; header alone returns []. Implement totals(rows) over parse_ledger output, aggregating by category with Decimal, returning a dict inserted in lexicographic category order and values as two-decimal strings. Negative amounts are allowed. Implement CLI: python module.py reads CSV from stdin; print JSON {"rows":...,"totals":...} ensure_ascii=False; invalid input -> exit2 and concise stderr without traceback. Document API, CLI, validation, exact Decimal rounding, Unicode and official reference. Modify module.py and README.md only. Never edit tests/build/.autopilot. Run python test_module.py and python build.py.
